title: Random-Matrix-Theory Filtering of the LLM Agreement Matrix to Find a 'Systemic' Eigenmode

original_idea.body:
# Random-Matrix-Theory Filtering of the LLM Agreement Matrix

Build a model x query agreement matrix over a panel of open models, compute its eigenspectrum, use the Marchenko-Pastur bound to separate signal from noise, and interpret the leading eigenvector as the systemic hivemind factor. Inference + linear algebra.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Level 3: plausible chain (systemic eigenmode aids monitoring) but the catastrophic link is indirect/methodological.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Level 4: build an agreement matrix and apply Marchenko-Pastur RMT; needs linear-algebra fluency but well-defined.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Level 4: focused deliverable (systemic factor + per-model loadings) with matrix construction as a dependency.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Level 4: public models + linear algebra, monitoring metric labs underweight, no internal access.

novelty.reasoning: RMT filtering of an LLM agreement matrix appears largely novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: No known RMT analysis of an LLM cross-model agreement matrix.
